report.summary: No blocking issues; the change can merge. The deferred-turn reconnect test now holds the real /v1/connect response in the fake instead of sleeping 100 ms. While it is held, the queue runner cannot start the turn: kickQueue runs only after openAndHello sets core.tempod, and sendPrompt does not wait for the socket, so the hold cannot deadlock. The release in onTestFinished runs even when the test fails, and the same hold/release pattern is already used by holdHealth in workspace-rpc.test.ts. The docs-only CI path now installs only the root package (--filter tempo); it runs only bunx oxlint/oxfmt, the anti-slop plugin needs only @oxlint/plugins (a root devDependency), Chromium and the Playwright version are skipped, and an unknown base still installs everything. The image workflow and Dockerfile.test filter to tempo plus @tempo/tempod; check:versions (effect), build:tempod (turbo), the daemon's imports (effect, ACP SDK, @tempo/protocol, @tempo/settings, ulid, yaml) and container/pi/tempo-profile.ts (Node built-ins only) all stay inside that set. The production Dockerfile has no bun install. The spec (06) and CI.md were updated in the same change. Nothing was run during this review: Bun execution needed approval, so the Bun --filter behaviour is confirmed by reading only.

findings.text: Not confirmed by running: Bun 1.4.2 must accept the root package name 'tempo' as a --filter together with --frozen-lockfile and install the root devDependencies (turbo, effect, oxlint). The author reports a local run (251 and 215 packages installed). The image workflow runs only on pushes to main, so a regression would not show in PR CI. The first image-workflow run on main after merging, or a manual run of that workflow, would confirm it.

evidence.why: Correctness depends on how Bun's workspace filter matches the root package. I could not run bun to confirm it.

findings.text: Docs-only lint now runs without workspace node_modules. The oxlint 'import' plugin rules in the correctness category normally skip imports they cannot resolve, and the source is identical to the base on this path, so results should not change. A passing docs-only CI run would confirm it.

evidence.why: Lint module resolution differs from the previous full install; the risk is low but was not observed in a run.

checked.risk: Real contracts: DO reconnect path versus the fake /v1/connect gate (connectTempod, openTempodSocket, scheduleReconnect, kickQueue gating)

Tests: sleep replaced by observable state, cleanup on failure, no deadlock because sendPrompt does not wait for the socket, a real assertion that no session.prompt was sent while held, same pattern as the existing holdHealth test
Build environment: the filtered install covers root tooling and the daemon dependency set used by check:versions, build:tempod, daemon tests and container scripts
Failure paths: docs-only classification fails closed (unknown base still does the full install); Chromium and Playwright steps are gated on docs_only
Spec and repository rules: 06 Build Plan and CI.md updated in the same change; no added dependencies, jobs or deadline changes
Security and idempotency: not affected (test-only fake and CI install scope; no secrets or production code paths changed)
